review.official:
This nomadic warrior from the
Far East
joined
Rhodes Island
by sheer chance.
What Matoimaru lacks in strategic acumen, she makes up with a mean giant sickle swing.

files.description:
Imaging tests on this Operator show clear outlines of internal organs, with no abnormal dark spots or shadows. No unusual traces of Originium particles present in the circulatory system, no signs of infection, confirming this operator as uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0% 
Operator Matoimaru showed no symptoms of Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L 
Operator Matoimaru rarely comes into contact with Originium.

Matoimaru is a magnificent warrior from the Far East.
She is simpleminded and prone to deception. She does catch on, but a new trick will fool her again.
Her hobbies, at which she excels, are sparring, soccer, and floral arrangement. She has been known to organize events around these subjects, though her idea of organization is typically dragging people kicking and screaming into it.

The Oni are still a mystery to most people. Aside from living in the Far East, there seems to be little in common among the race. 
However, Matoimaru is yet even more different from other Oni: Her bloodlust makes her performance on the battlefield strikingly unique, though it seems she's not aware of this fact.

Many Operators think Matoimaru is crude and unrefined, but they are mistaken.
They just need to check out her floral arrangements, on display every Saturday at 3pm. 
The beauty she can create is positively astonishing.

Matoimaru is obviously self-conscious about her flaws: She is not good at controlling her strength or at critical thinking. 
She took up floral arrangement to refine herself and to show the others they don't need to fear her. 
Despite this, she's remains quite gullible. At least she has learned to question the idea that she must be a great thinker in order to survive. 
As far as she is concerned, her ideal companion would be someone who won't deceive or betray her, and will stay with her and guide her. How wonderful that would be...

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, you gotta be hungry! Try some of my onigiri. They're great!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I've got a lotta hobbies: martial art sparring, soccer… Oh! And Ikebana! Some took me as a warrior with more brawn than brains, and I'd say they're the ones who's got a fat head!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My race eats other races? That's some old crap! Who told you that? Tch, those cowards, cooking up this nonsense behind my back. When I find'em, I'll give'em a lesson they'll never forget!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I'm born with this self-healing body. Even if I take a few cuts in the fight, the wounds will close back up in no time.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Hey, Doctor, Rhodes Island's got a soccer tournament! C'mon, let's sign up together! No need to think twice! Just put me in your team, and it's in the bag. You'd better work your brain elsewhere, like a cool victory pose!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: You don't even recognize me on the battlefield? I just start cutting through enemies with a face as cold as my blade? Wow! Sounds hella badass! Wish I could watch myself out there.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I got this problem where I kinda end up breaking stuff, so I'm working with my Ikebana teacher to control my strength. Besides, getting surrounded by all those pretty flowers makes me real happy!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Strategy? Ehh, not really my forte. That's why I keep hopping right into the enemy's plans. But you, Doctor, you always stop me right before I lose my mind. Real nice to have you by my side.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Actually, I've always been a gullible dummy. Got duped so bad in the past that I almost got myself killed a few times. But now I, Matoimaru, swear loyalty to you, Doctor! Because I know you'll never betray me.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Grr... Hey, no falling asleep, Doctor! I need a listener or I'm gonna die of boredom!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Matoimaru, here to join Rhodes Island! My blade is at your command, Doctor!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: More fancy skills to beat those bad guys with!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, put my strength to good work. That'll be the respect I deserve.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, please stand back a bit. I don't want to hurt you when swinging my naginata. But I, Matoimaru, will bring us every victory in your name.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Hah hah! You all look pretty tough. How about a warm-up with me?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Ugh, you want me to play captain? Then how am I suppose to throw myself into the battle!?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: You guys ready to rumble? Then what are we waiting for!?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, bad guys!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm over here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Just how long until it's my turn?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Love that battlefield smell.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Make 'em shake in their boots!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Standing up to me? Haha, Ballsy!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Ready to meet your demise?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: My blade shall rip you and your toy to ribbons!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You end here!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: A sea of fire and a mountain of blades... Now that's what I call a fight. This is the battlefield I've always dreamed of.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, I got 'em all! Huh? what happened here? Everything's busted… Um, wait a second, did I do it...?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I'll get 'em before they escape! Can't call the battle over unless we got every last of 'em!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Retreat! I'll cover your escape. Make sure you don't get hit!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Agh! Ow! My horn...!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Huh?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: What's with that smile on your face? Anything to share with me?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Hey, Doctor, how does Rhodes Island celebrate the New Year? Oh, anything is welcome? Haha, alright then, I'll put together a soccer match with Matterhorn and the others! Make sure you come to watch!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Uh huh, I'm listening.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! I wanted to fill your office with flowers, but my teacher said restraint is the first rule of Ikebana. So I made you this! And it should fit just fine on your desk!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: This blade brings nothing but trouble when I'm holding it. Good thing I can trust you to tell me where to swing it. That way, nothing can go wrong!
